name: 真乃
text: ほ、ほわ……っ
trans: Ho-Howa......

name: 円香
text: Why……？

name: 真乃
text:
あ……
あの、お疲れさまです……っ
trans:
Ah......
Erm, hello there......

name: 円香
text: お疲れ
trans: Hello.

name: 円香
text: 櫻木さんもおやつ？
trans:
Are you here to get snacks too,
Sakuragi-san?

name: 真乃
text: う、うん……っ

name: 円香
text: このガトーショコラ、おすすめ
trans: This chocolate cake is good.

name: 真乃
text:
ほわ……
これ、食べたことなかったかも……
trans:
Howa......
I don't think I've ever had this before......

name: 円香
text:
小分けになってて
ひと切れで結構おなかに溜まるから
trans:
It's cut into small pieces,
but even one slice fills up the stomach.

name: 円香
text:
レッスン前後で何か食べたい時とか
結構いい
trans:
So it's a great choice when you want to snack
on something before or after a lesson.

name: 真乃
text:
そうなんですね……
ありがとうございますっ
trans:
Oh, I see......
Thank you for the recommendation.

name: 円香
text: ……敬語
trans: ......So formal.

name: 真乃
text: え？
trans: Huh?

name: 円香
text: 浅倉には使ってないでしょ
trans:
You aren't that formal speaking to Asakura,
right?

name: 円香
text:
私も外していい
楽な方で
trans:
There's no need to be formal with me, too.
Whichever's convenient.

name: 真乃
text:
じゃ、じゃあ……
……うん……っ

name: 円香
text: ごめんね
trans: I'm sorry.

name: 円香
text:
固まってるでしょ、うちら
いつまで経っても
trans:
Still pretty rigid, aren't we.
No matter how long we've known each other.

name: 円香
text: 話しかけづらいって感じるのも────
trans:
Striking up a conversation feels difficult
too────

name: 真乃
text: ────ふふっ
trans: ────Fufu.

name: 円香
trans: ......Hm, did I say something weird?

name: 真乃
text:
ふふ、ごめんね……
透ちゃんも、前におんなじこと言ってたから……
trans:
Fufu, I'm sorry...
Toru-chan said the same thing to me, a while before...

name: 真乃
text:
あのね……
私も……
trans:
You know......
I feel the same.....

name: 真乃
text: ……合宿、すごく楽しみにしてたんだ……
trans: ......I was so looking forward to the training camp......

name: 真乃
text:
もしかしたらノクチルのみんなとも
もっと仲良くなれるかなって……
trans:
Cos I thought that we could maybe get along even
better with everyone in noctchill......

name: 真乃
text:
だけど、なかなか思ったようにできなくて……
……こんなに近くに、一緒にいるのになって……思ってた
trans:
But looks like it's not really working out like I hoped......
......Even though we're now together here, and are
standing so close to each other......

name: 真乃
text: よ、よかったら……なんだけど……
trans: J-Just asking if you think it's a good idea... but...

name: 真乃
text: おやつ、みんなで一緒に……どうかな……っ
trans: How about... we all have snacks together...?

name: 円香
text: いいんじゃない？
trans: Why not?

name: 真乃
text: ほわ……
trans: Howa......

name: 真乃
text:
私、それじゃあ……みんなの分も
買ってくるね……っ
trans: Erm, then I...... I'll buy enough snacks for everyone......

name: 円香
text:
半々
私も出すから
trans:
Just half.
Cos I'm buying the other half.
